corrections.reason: Locked expectations that could never be machine-checked or were wrong; see each derivation. Categories: text (rewritten numerically, nothing loosened), fraction (bare fraction read as percent: loosens absolute window), disputed (value re-derived).

expected.basis: Locked bound ripple <= I/(2fC) = 0.677 V, as the range [0, 0.677] V: centre 0.3385, half-width 0.3385.

BEH-DIO-BRIDGE/B2.derivation: The locked value is text (a list, bound, band, window or qualitative outcome) that cannot be compared numerically. Rewritten as one numeric item per stated quantity, keeping every stated number; a band or window becomes its centre with half-width tolerance.

expected.basis: Reverse-polarity DC case B: the current flows through two diode groups in series, each group is two diodes in parallel carrying I/2: solve I = (5 - 2*Vd(I/2))/100 with Vd(I)=N*Vt*ln(I/IS+1)+I*RS (IS=4.023e-9 N=1.8 RS=0.03, 27 C). Printed name br3_ib is case B (original label 'reverse DC current'). Measured differs 4e-6 relative.

Case A (PLUS to +5 V through 100 ohm, MINUS at 0 V): the bridge is reverse biased, only leakage flows (about 2*IS = 8e-9 A through the series diodes). Bound |I| < 1e-6 A from the original, written as value 0 with absolute tolerance 1e-6 (measured 8.06e-9).

BEH-DIO-BRIDGE/B3.derivation: The locked value is text (a list, bound, band, window or qualitative outcome) that cannot be compared numerically. Rewritten as one numeric item per stated quantity, keeping every stated number; a band or window becomes its centre with half-width tolerance.

expected.basis: trr = storage time + RC tail. Storage: dQ/dt = -(VR+Vd(Q/TT))/R - Q/TT from Q0=TT*IF=230 pC to 0, i.e. ts = integral dQ/(IR(Q)+Q/TT) = 3.212 ns (the original rule of thumb TT*ln(1+IF/IR)=3.19 ns uses a constant IR=67 mA and is the lower limit). RC tail: the depletion capacitance Cj(u)=CJO/(1+u/VJ)^M (CJO=2 pF, VJ=0.7, M=0.4) is charged from 0 to -5.9 V through R=100 ohm with current (6-u)/100, t = integral 100*Cj(u)/(6-u) du = 0.382 ns until |i| = 1 mA. Sum 3.594 ns. The original item (storage estimate only, '3.2 ns +/-20%') omitted the tail and passed only at its edge (3.83 ns measured). Tolerance 10% because the diffusion charge in the tail and the forward-bias depletion charge (FC=0.5) are neglected; measured is 6.6% above. Datasheet limit trr <= 4 ns also holds.

BEH-DIO-PN/B2.derivation: The locked value was re-derived and found wrong for the stated circuit; the corrected value comes from the derivation below, not from the measured result. Original storage-only estimate 3.2 ns omitted the depletion-charge tail: storage integral 3.21 ns + tail 0.38 ns = 3.59 ns, 10%. Datasheet limit <= 4 ns is still met.

expected.basis: Stable fixed point of Tj = Ta + Rth*P25*exp(a(Tj-25)), P25 = 0.2m*40 = 8 mW, a = ln(25)/75, Rth=88 K/W, Ta=60 C: Tj = 63.7072 C (root found by bracketing, stable branch). Absolute 0.1 C from the original; measured 63.70718.

Ta = 95 C is above the runaway threshold Ta* = 25 + ln(1/(Rth*P25*a*e))/a = 83.24 C, so Tj = Ta + Rth*P25*exp(a(Tj-25)) has no solution and dTj/dt >= (1+ln(a c))/a/(Rth Cth) = 13.37 K/s for c = Rth*P25*exp(a(Ta-25)) (minimum over Tj of the right side). Flag = 1 when Tj(2.5 s) exceeds Ta + 2.5 s * 13.37 K/s = 128.4 C (simulated 152.65 C, i.e. diverging). The simulation is stopped at 2.5 s because the finite-time blow-up (about 2.8 s) aborts ngspice. Flag value is exactly 1, tolerance 0.

BEH-DIO-SCHOTTKY/B3.derivation: The locked value is text (a list, bound, band, window or qualitative outcome) that cannot be compared numerically. Rewritten as one numeric item per stated quantity, keeping every stated number; a band or window becomes its centre with half-width tolerance. 'diverges' at Ta 95 C becomes flag sch3_runaway = 1: Tj(2.5 s) exceeds Ta + 2.5 s x the analytic minimum rise rate (13.37 K/s); no root exists above Ta* = 83.24 C.

expected.basis: Peak open-secondary voltage in the first saturation spike (t < 1 us). The original header expectation V = Lsec*w*Is_pk = 235.6 V (zero-crossing slope, 5%) is NOT what the model produces, because the interwinding capacitance CIW=1 pF (0.5 pF effective at s1) is reflected as N^2*C = 20 nF across the saturated magnetizing inductance and rings with it (about 10 MHz, +/-230 V), so the peak is lower than the ideal slope at the first spike and then depends on ring-down. Derivation: the circuit reduces to the second-order ODE v = N*L(iL)*d(iL)/dt - RS*(C dv/dt), iL = Ip - (N-1)*C*dv/dt (L(i)=Lm[LR+(1-LR)sech^2(i/ia)], Lm=LP-LLK, ia=0.0787 A), integrated in python (LSODA, rtol 1e-10, max step 0.1 ns): first peak 147.73 V at 0.1907 us. ngspice converges to 147.93 V (steps 0.25 ns to 0.05 ns, 147.86 V at the deck's 0.5 ns); tolerance 1%. BEH-TRN-MOSFET/B9.derivation: 2N7000 threshold spread (0.8/1.9/3.0 V) with 3.3 V gate drive: drain current spread. Printing only: currents re-exported in mA; no include in this deck.

expected.basis: II = (VI - VB1)/2.7k. The header estimate 2Vbe=1.4 V (0.907 mA) ignores that the saturated Darlington carries IC=(12-1.1)/50=0.218 A: VB1 = Vbe2 + IE2*re2 + Vbe1 with Vbe2=Vt*ln(0.218/1e-13)=0.735 V (+ re=1.5 ohm*0.22 A = 0.33 V, + rb drop), Vbe1=Vt*ln(IE1/1e-14) with IE1~Ib2+VB2/3k~2.6 mA -> 0.68 V; fixed-point solve gives VB1=1.751 V -> II=(3.85-1.751)/2.7k=0.777 mA. 3% tolerance covers neglected Early/ikf/saturation effects (measured is 1.7% lower)
Same fixed point, VB1=1.751 V: (5-1.751)/2.7k = 1.203 mA (measured 1.5% lower; tolerance 3% as above)

Peak = V(COM) + VF at the coil current at turn-off. IL0=(12-Vce)/50 with Vce(sat)~1.1 V -> 0.218 A; clamp diode (is=1e-11,n=1,rs=3.4, Vt=25.86 mV): VF=Vt*ln(0.218/1e-11)+3.4*0.218 = 0.6155+0.7412 = 1.357 V -> 13.357 V (sensitivity 3.5 ohm*dI, so +-2 mA gives +-7 mV). Header band 13.5..14.2 was wrong: the datasheet VF 1.7..2.0 V is specified at 350 mA, not at 0.22 A
